# TildaZ v0.8.0

**Text finally looks the way your shell asked for it.**

- Underlines (single, double, curly, dotted, dashed), strikethrough, overline,
  blink, and real italic and bold faces now render — until now the terminal
  parsed these and drew none of them.
  ([#365](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/365),
  [#374](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/374),
  [#375](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/375),
  [#376](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/376))
- A new tab opens in the active tab's directory instead of your home directory.
  ([#366](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/366))
- Emoji- and CJK-heavy output draws far faster: the time spent rendering is
  down 79-96% depending on the platform, and Windows now holds a full 60 fps
  instead of 38.8. ([#399](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/399),
  [#386](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/386))
- Font names accept PostScript names, different casing, and spacing, and when a
  name cannot be matched TildaZ names the font that replaced it.
  ([#406](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/406),
  [#409](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/409),
  [#405](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/405))
- Combining marks, and clusters split across two fonts, are drawn in place on
  all three platforms. ([#401](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/401),
  [#415](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/415),
  [#418](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/418),
  [#420](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/420))

## Upgrade notes

- **Linux: a font name that is not installed now stops startup** with a dialog
  instead of quietly drawing with a different font, matching macOS and Windows.
  Fix the typo in `font.family` or install the font.
  ([#406](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/406))
- **New configs default to 10,000 scrollback lines** instead of 100,000; an
  existing `config_N.json` keeps whatever `max_scroll_lines` it already has.
  ([#425](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/425))
- **Two instances configured with the same hotkey no longer both start.** The
  higher-numbered instance stops and names the instance it collides with.
  ([#431](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/431))
- `tildaz --version` and `tildaz --help` now work from the command line, and
  the version string carries the build commit.
  ([#383](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/383))
- Windows: keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`, and the macOS artifact is
  still self-signed rather than Apple-notarized — both unchanged from v0.7.0.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.8.0-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.8.0-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.8.0-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.8.0-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.8.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.8.0-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.8.0-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.8.0-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |

## Known limitations

- [#266](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/266): TildaZ does not answer
  terminal queries such as DA1, DSR, or OSC color requests, which can delay
  fish shell startup by about ten seconds on Linux and macOS.
- [#347](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/347): on Cinnamon, a session
  that reports no keyboard or pointer capability at login can leave input dead
  with no retry path.
- [#194](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/194): on Linux, Korean IME
  input can stop working after focusing an X11 Electron window such as VSCode.
- On Linux, yielding z-order on focus loss is not implemented —
  `zwlr_layer_shell_v1` layers have no normal-window slot.
